approvers: Owner decides alone; main contractor may have a say on site access
reason: We spend about 1,500 euro a year on damage at snagging. At 19 euro per m2 a 1,000 m2 year would cost 19,000, more than ten times what the problem costs us. It makes no sense.
objection: In July and August half the façade is in full sun, so when can anyone even apply and peel it? And I'd pay 19 euro per m2 to avoid a cost I carry at near zero.
instead: Keep doing nothing, or use cheap film and tape on the worst items, and pay for the odd cleaning or replacement from the job contingency.
would_change_my_mind: A price near film and tape level, under 2 euro per m2 all-in, or the main contractor paying for it and writing it into the contract.
